director.text: Hi Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj cricket ke through fractions, yaani barabar hisse, dekhenge. Tumhe cricket mein batting pasand hai ya bowling?
Riya, maine batting ya bowling poochha tha; “haan” se choice clear nahi hui. Cricket ke baad roti ke do barabar tukdon mein se kaunsa logi?
Riya, koi bhi tukda le sakti ho; dono barabar hain. Aise ek tukde ko half, yaani aadha, kehte hain. Tumne kitne tukdon mein se ek liya?
Ab sawaal hai: 15 pencils ka ek tihai kya hai?
Riya, meri baat achanak badal gayi. Pehle equal groups ka matlab dekhein: 1/3 mein ek group kitne barabar groups mein se hai?

director.text: Riya, tumne kya kaha, main clearly sun nahi paayi. Ek baar phir bolo: 1/3 matlab kitne equal groups mein se 1 group?
